finding.summary: The three old command names (pr-review, pr-review-plugin, pr-review-performance) are removed from the dispatcher with no backward-compatible aliases. Any existing automation, CI jobs, cron entries, scripts, or documentation that invoke `mesh pr-review` (or the other removed names) will now fail with 'ERROR: unknown command' and exit 1. Because the failure is at the CLI surface, it will surface as broken tooling for callers outside this repo that cannot be updated in lockstep with this rename.
finding.fix: Keep the old names as deprecated aliases that forward to the new command, e.g. `pr-review|pr-review-plugin|pr-review-performance) echo "WARNING: '$cmd' is deprecated, use 'review-pull-request'" >&2; shift; exec "$SCRIPTS_DIR/review-pull-request" "$@" ;;`, and only remove them after a deprecation window. Alternatively, if a hard cut-over is intended, ensure all in-repo and documented callers are updated in this same PR and note the breaking change in the release notes.
